name: Flex API
description:
Flex's tenant API for integrations and AI agents. Every response is scoped to the organization that owns the presented key.

**Authentication.** Send `Authorization: Bearer flx_live_…` on every request. Keys are created by an organization administrator inside Flex; the secret is shown once and stored hashed. A key belongs to exactly one organization.

**Permissions.** A key is granted a subset of Flex permissions when it is created. Each endpoint states the permission it needs; a key without it receives 403. `GET /api/v1/modules` lists the permissions of the presented key.

**Modules.** Endpoints that belong to an optional Flex module (scheduling, invoicing, …) answer 403 with a problem detail when the organization has not activated that module. `GET /api/v1/modules` shows which modules are active.

**Rate limits.** Fixed one-minute windows, per key (default 120 requests/min, configurable per key) and per organization (600/min). Every response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (seconds until the key's window resets) so a client can pace itself. Exceeding either limit returns 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).

**Pagination.** List endpoints return `{ "items": [...], "nextCursor": "…" }`. Pass `after=<nextCursor>` to fetch the next page and `limit` to size it (1–200, default 50). `nextCursor` is null on the last page; cursors are opaque and stable.

**CSV.** Every list endpoint (`GET /api/v1/activity`, `/categories`, `/customers`, `/customers/{id}/locations`, `/jobs`, `/jobs/{id}/photos`, `/invoices`, `/items`, `/items/low-stock`, `/items/{id}/reorder-points`, `/items/{id}/units`, `/labor-rates`, `/locations`, `/purchase-orders`, `/reorder-points`, `/roles`, `/sales-orders`, `/schedule`, `/schedule-groups`, `/transfers`, `/users`, `/users/removal-requests`, `/vendors`) also answers in CSV: send `Accept: text/csv` or append `?format=csv`. Columns are the JSON property names in declaration order — a nested object is flattened to `parent.child` columns, a list of scalars is `;`-joined, a list of objects is compact JSON in the cell; values are written exactly as in the JSON (invariant decimals, ISO-8601 UTC dates, enum names, `true`/`false`, empty for null). The file is UTF-8 with BOM, CRLF rows, RFC 4180 quoting, and a text cell starting with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, TAB or CR is prefixed with an apostrophe so spreadsheets do not run it as a formula. Paging is identical to JSON; because the CSV body has no envelope the next page's cursor is returned in the `X-Next-Cursor` header together with `Link: <next page URL>; rel="next"` (absent on the last page). Responses are attachments named `<resource>.csv`. `GET /api/v1/modules` and single-resource GETs are JSON only.

**ETags.** Single-resource and list GETs return a weak `ETag`. Send it back as `If-None-Match` to receive 304 Not Modified with no body when nothing changed. A list's tag is per representation — the JSON and CSV tags of the same page differ — and list responses carry `Vary: Accept`.

**Idempotency.** Send an `Idempotency-Key` header (any unique string, up to 128 characters) on POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE. Replaying the same key with the same body returns the original response instead of repeating the write; the same key with a different body is rejected with 422. Keys are remembered for 24 hours per organization.

**Errors.** Failures are RFC 7807 `application/problem+json`: 400 validation errors list per-field messages under `errors`; 401/403/404/409/422/429/500 carry `title`, `detail` and a `traceId` to quote in support requests.
